name: Part Supervision
definition: Starts each part of the platform when the host starts, and starts each part again when it stops.
rationale: A part cannot start itself again, and Self-Observation stops with the parts that it watches (RSK-SO-002). DEC-176.

name: Part Isolation
definition: Holds each part to the network and to the storage that it is given.
rationale: A fence that the fenced part holds is a promise: a library inside a part can open a connection that the part does not intend. REQ-PL-033 and REQ-PL-024 hold only where something outside each part refuses (OPN-095, DEC-130). DEC-176.

name: Resource Bounds
definition: Holds each part within its allocation of memory and of storage, and reserves storage for the work of the platform itself.
rationale: A part that takes the memory of the host stops the other parts, and a platform whose storage is full cannot start or make its copy. DEC-179.
